```{r}
library(readxl)
data2 <- read.delim("clipboard", dec = ",")
```

```{r}
model.reg<-lm(Yt~Y.t.1.+Xt,data=data2)
model.reg
```

```{r}
library("dLagM")
data <- read.delim("clipboard", dec = ",")
model.koyck=koyckDlm(x=data$Xt, y=data$Yt)
```

```{r}
data("USMacroG",package="AER")
plot(USMacroG[,c("dpi","consumption")],lty=c(3,1),lwd=2,plot.type="single",ylab="")
legend("topleft", legend=c("income","consumption"),lwd=2,lty=c(3,1),bty="n")
```

```{r}
library("dynlm")
cons_lm1<-dynlm(consumption~dpi+L(dpi),data=USMacroG)
cons_lm2<-dynlm(consumption~dpi+L(consumption),data=USMacroG)

summary(cons_lm1)
summary(cons_lm2)
```

```{r}
deviance(cons_lm1)
deviance(cons_lm2)
```
